text:
emma: Quick syncproposal: cohort-based quota reshuffle. Instead of strict per-tenant buckets, group low-variance tenants into soft-cohorts so we can reallocate idle capacity quickly during bursts. Goal: improve headroom utilization without increasing unfairness.
liam: Sounds promising. How do you pick cohorts? by historical 95th percent token rate + model mix?
rishi: +1 for using quantiles. Suggest time-decayed features so cohorts adapt to growth. Also need deterministic hashing to avoid flapping between cohorts on small changes.
tanya: operational concern: cohorts change = audit confusion. We need to surface mapping in logs and expose cohort id in billing/alerts. Add cohort_history with timestamps.
emma: agreed. Sketch: compute features per tenant: median_tokens_1h, p95_tokens_24h, model_entropy. Run offline clustering daily; assign cohort_id. During admission, check cohort debt + tenant local allowance. Policy: tenant_allowance = min(static_reserved, cohort_pool*share + baseline).
alex: telemetry cost notewe'll add cohort_id dimension to admission metrics; estimate +10% metric cardinality. Can we sample for high-cardinality tenants?
liam: fairness: need per-tenant floor so cohorts can't starve small customers. propose conservative floor = max(min_quota, historical_avg * 0.5). Also cap per-tenant burst from cohort at 20% of cohort_pool.
rishi: abuse detection: cohort pooling could be gamed by colluding tenants. Mitigation: detect correlated spikes across cohort and temporarily isolate suspected tenants. Also add per-tenant anomaly score that bypasses pooling if >threshold.
tanya: migration plan: 1) offline clustering + dry-run labels 2) expose cohort_id in dashboards for 7 days 3) enable probe-mode pooling (metrics only) 4) 2-week canary with 5% traffic pooling 5) progressive ramp.
emma: API sketch for admission call (probe/enforce modes):
```
POST /v1/admit
{ "tenant": "t-42", "model": "redwood-rl", "tokens": 300, "mode": "probe" }
-> { "allowed": true, "decision_source": "cohort:cr-17", "tenant_floor": 120, "cohort_remaining": 51200 }
```
liam: storage: cohort metadata small. We store mapping {tenant->cohort, version, assigned_at}. Admission reads one extra key; prefer caching in frontdoor for hot tenants.
alex: implementation options: A) central cohort service with Redis cache B) embed cohort mapping in distro config pushed to proxies. My vote: central service + CDN-like TTL pushes for larger private deployments.
rishi: privacy: if customers request cohort opt-out, we must honor and keep them isolated. Also document enterprise escape hatch.
tanya: runbook: if cohort pooling increases p95 failure rate or false-rejects>0.15%, revert to per-tenant enforcement. Add automated telemetry check daily.
ops-bot: rollout scheduled: cohort-clusterer v1 -> eu-central dry-run at 2026-01-12T03:00Z.
emma: next steps: PR for clustering job + schema, small dashboard for cohort exposure, and client lib change. I'll own the clustering job. Assignments: @liam admission changes, @rishi abuse integration, @alex metrics/dashboards, @tanya ops/runbooks. React with :eyes: if you can.
